description:
About the company
 Our client is a financial services technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Serve as the engineer responsible for the shared technical foundation that a small product engineering group builds on. Emphasis is on dependable, cost-conscious and fast systems, with strong attention to security and compliance expectations.
 What you'll do
 - Design and run core services and the environments they operate in.
 - Create secure, isolated environments where automated AI workloads can run safely.
 - Build internal tools that make day-to-day engineering work smoother and quicker.
 - Tune speed and spending as traffic and data volumes rise.
 - Keep the technical foundation steady as the business grows and takes on new entities.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - A track record of designing and owning shared internal systems or engineering tools at a fast-moving technology company.
 - Strong skills in designing server-side software, including APIs, databases and data pipelines.
 - Practical experience running workloads in the cloud, using containers and automating releases.
 Bonus points
 - Experience keeping systems steady through fast expansion or company mergers.
 - Background in a regulated sector such as fintech, healthcare or finance.
 - Familiarity with sandboxing and safe execution of untrusted code.
 - Experience with data warehousing and query tuning.
 - Experience building or integrating infrastructure for AI agents.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - New York, NY, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
